blocks.text: Space ko teen jihati (three-dimensional) phailao kaha jata hai jis mein tamam cheezein aur waqiaat hote hain. Yeh kisi force ke asar mein mukhtalif cheezon ki jagah aur harkat bayan karne ka dhancha deta hai.

Time waqiaat ki tarteeb aur muddat napta hai. Theory of relativity mein time mutlaq nahi; ise chautha dimension mana jata hai. Maslan jhoolte pendulum jaisi oscillatory harkat oscillations ki frequency maloom karne ke liye time par munhasir hai. Ek aur misal time dilation hai, jo is chapter mein pehle aaya, jis mein bohat tez speed par chalte observer ke liye waqt aaram wale ke muqable dheema guzarta hai. Special theory of relativity dikhati hai ke space aur time aapas mein jure hain; kitab mazeed kehti hai ke yeh batati hai ke gravity aur speed space aur time par kaise asar karti hain, jaise sitaron jaise bhaari ajsaam ke gird roshni ka murna, jo asraat Einstein ki general theory se mutalliq hain.

blocks.title: Space-time
blocks.text: Space-time ek riyazi model hai jo space aur time ko ek musalsal (continuum) mein jorta hai. Yeh space aur time ke tamam nuqton aur un ke aapas ke rishte bayan karne ke liye istemal hota hai. Ise aisi chadar samjha ja sakta hai jo mur sakti hai; is ka murna aise asraat deta hai jaise gravitational waves guzarne par cheezon ka khinchna aur dabna.

Einstein ke nazariye ke mutabiq space-time kham-daar hai, khaas kar bhaari ajsaam ke qareeb aur light ki speed ke qareeb speeds par. Hum ise kapre ki chadar ke taur par soch sakte hain: agar chadar par bhaari gend rakhi jaye to woh mur jati hai (Fig. 11.2). Sitare aur sayyare apne gird space-time ko morte hain, jaise lachakdar kapra gend thamne par bigarta hai; jism jitna bhaari, kham utna gehra. Nateeje mein hum jismon par gravity ki force ki baat nahi karte; balke kehte hain ke jism aur roshni ki shuaein kham-daar space-time mein geodesics (hamwar geometry ki seedhi lakeeron ke mushabeh) par chalti hain. Yun bhaari jism ke qareeb aaram mein ya aahista chalta jism us ki taraf geodesic par chalta hai.

blocks.alt: Gehrai mein dikhai gayi murabba jaali (grid) wali chadar jis ke beech gehre gaddhe mein bhari neela gola rakha hai; jaali ki lakeerein gole ki taraf neeche jhuk jati hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.2: Bhari gola kapre ki chadar ko jhuka deta hai (kitab ki Figure 11.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Einstein ka nazariya gravity ke kaam ki tabai tasveer deta hai. Newton ne gravity ka inverse-square qanoon daryaft kiya magar saaf kaha ke woh is ki koi wajah nahi batate ke gravity is qanoon par kyun chalti hai. Einstein ka nazariya bhi gravity ko inverse-square qanoon par chalta batata hai (taqatwar gravitational fields ke siwa), magar wajah bhi batata hai. Isi liye Einstein ka nazariya Newton se aage ka qadam mana jata hai, agarche yeh Newton ke nazariye ko shamil karta hai aur bohat taqatwar gravitational fields ke siwa wahi nataij deta hai.

Suraj ki gravity se sitaron ki roshni ka murna 1919 ke Suraj grahan (solar eclipse) mein napa gaya. Nataij Newton ki bajaye Einstein ke nazariye se mel khaye, aur Einstein ke nazariye ko scientific kamyabi qarar diya gaya. Sitare A ki roshni Zameen aate hue Suraj ke qareeb se guzar kar murti hai, to hum sitare ko zahiri simt B mein, zawiya phi khiska hua, dekhte hain; Einstein ne phi = 1.745 seconds of arc ki peshgoi ki, aur 1919 ke grahan mein yahi qeemat mili (Interesting Information). Einstein ke nazariye ki ek aur kamyabi gravitational waves ki daryaft thi, jo kuch falaki waqiaat se space-time ke kham mein khalal (dabao aur khinchav) se paida hoti hain; yeh 2015 mein pakri gayin aur 2016 mein elaan hua.

blocks.alt: Baen taraf Suraj. Sitare A se shua (ray) neeche aati hai, Suraj ke kinare ke qareeb se guzarti hai aur Zameen (To Earth) ki taraf jate hue Suraj ki taraf thora mur jati hai. Dashed lakeer Zameen tak aane wali shua ko peeche zahiri jagah B tak barhati hai; zawiya phi A wali shua aur dashed lakeer ke darmiyan hai.
blocks.caption: Interesting Information (PDF page 257): Suraj se sitaron ki roshni ka murna (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Hamari aankh roshni ko us simt mein dekhti hai jis simt se woh aakhir mein aati hai. Suraj ke qareeb roshni Suraj ki taraf mur jati hai, is liye Zameen se sitara asal jagah A ki bajaye seedhi peeche wali jagah B par, Suraj se thora door, nazar aata hai. Yeh farq phi bohat chhota hai (taqreeban 1.75 seconds of arc); khaake mein samajhne ke liye bara dikhaya gaya hai.

Ek spaceship light ki aadhi speed se ek sitare ki taraf jata hai, aur Zameen ke observer ke hisab se wahan pohanchne mein aath saal lagte hain. Zameen ke nuqta-e-nazar se spaceship ki ghariyan dheemi chalti hain, to spaceship par Zameen se kam waqt guzarta hai. Spaceship walon ke liye safar ki lambai sukar gayi hai aur woh use kam waqt mein tay karte hain: woh 8 ki bajaye taqreeban 7 saal (8 x sqrt(1 - 0.25) = 6.9 saal) darj karte hain. Aap jitna tez chalein, ya gravity ke taqatwar source ke jitna qareeb hon, waqt aap ke liye utna dheema chalta hai (For Your Information); film 'Interstellar' ki tarah black hole ke qareeb bohat tez chalta spaceship har ghante mein Zameen ke 7 saal kho sakta hai (Interesting Information).

blocks.prompt: Space-time ke baare mein Einstein ka tasawwur bayan kijiye aur is ke mutabiq gravity ka nazariya bataiye (comprehensive question 11.3). Aisi misalein dijiye jahan special theory of relativity ke nataij ki tasdeeq hui (short question 11.10).
blocks.explanation: Space aur time ek chaar jihati musalsal, space-time, banate hain, jise mass aur energy morte hain, jaise bhaari gend lachakdar chadar mein garha banati hai; gravity force nahi balke is kham-daar space-time mein jismon aur roshni ka geodesics par chalna hai, jo inverse-square qanoon ki wajah batata aur sitaron ki roshni ke murne (1919) aur gravitational waves (2015) ki peshgoi karta hai. Special relativity ki tasdeeq tez chalte na-paidar zarron se hui jo time dilation ki wajah se aaram ke muqable zyada jeete hain, accelerators mein zarron ke zaid mass aur energy se, aur nuclear reactions mein azaad hone wali energy se jo E = mc^2 ke mutabiq hai.

items: Space: teen dimensions; time: chautha dimension, relativity mein mutlaq nahi. Space-time dono ko jorta hai; mass ise morta hai (chadar par bhaari gend, Fig. 11.2); jism aur roshni gravity ki force ki bajaye geodesics par chalte hain.

Einstein Newton ke inverse-square qanoon ki wajah batata aur us se aage jata hai: Suraj se sitaron ki roshni ka murna (1.745 seconds of arc, 1919 ka grahan); gravitational waves 2015 mein pakri gayin. c/2 par spaceship: Zameen par 8 saal, jahaz par taqreeban 7 saal.
